description: ASK US FOR WHAT IS NOT HERE. What would you like to buy? Tell us even if it is not in this inventory. If what you need is a machine-readable convention, or a property of one across a host population, we can usually measure it for you — and if we cannot, we will say so. Call the `request_capability` tool with `want` describing what you need. Free text is fine. A contact is optional and only used to reply. Free, no credential, no payment.

contact.description: Optional, only used to reply to you.

want.description: What you need. Free text. Required.

would_pay.description: Optional: what it would be worth to you.

name: request_capability
